meaning: The headline price is relayed by an aggregator rather than read from the bookmaker's own site; the bookmaker match URL is linked on the row so the price can be checked by hand.
A prediction-market listing existed for this fixture but its quote failed the feed's quality gate (spread, depth, degenerate or suspended price) and was not used.
The same team appears under more than one name or with a duplicate rating entry across sources; the alias the board matched on is recorded on the row.

The official standings row used for this team names a different spelling; the equivalence is documented with an evidence link and was re-checked against the committed standings line (name and points).
The outside market's favourite and this board's own originated line name different winners; both are published and the pick follows the market.
Neither the bookmaker relay nor Polymarket listed a usable price for this fixture in the current capture; if a price appears here it comes from another capture or from this board's own line.
An outside source lists one of the teams at the same kickoff against a different opponent; that listing was not used for either team's probability.
More than one research estimate exists for a fixture whose team is absent from the official standings; the board publishes a range and labels it unverified.
The headline probability comes from a prediction market (traded prices, no bookmaker margin); thin books move quickly.
The two published probabilities are within 2 points of each other; the pick is a coin-flip and is labelled as one.
